stemMd: A technical drawing states that written dimensions govern over measured paper lengths. A line measures 4 cm on a distorted print but is labelled 120 mm. What nominal length should be used?
explanationMd: The convention is explicitly stated: the labelled dimension takes precedence. Print distortion can alter paper measurements without changing the specified nominal size.

distractorRationale.a: The governing written dimension is supplied.
distractorRationale.d: This relies on the distorted print rather than the stated dimension.
distractorRationale.e: This also misconverts the measured paper length.
